title: Retro D20 Dice Roller with CRT Shader Effects
description: Explore this open-source 3D D20 dice roller built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript using Three.js. Featuring a pixelated retro CRT display effect, this interactive project simulates rolling a 20-sided die with realistic physics and glowing visuals. Click to roll, watch the die bounce, and see the result highlighted—all rendered with customizable shaders. Perfect for tabletop gaming enthusiasts or developers looking to experiment with WebGL and shader programming. Fork the code, tweak the config, and make it your own!
